releaseNotes:
1. Highlighted Inventory Action Toolbar: Styled with prominent slate/blue bar, streamlined search and category selector, and fixed Deals (6) button wrapping.
2. Fast Cashier 'Hide Photos' Mode: Main POS register toggle for experienced cashiers to ring up sales in high-density text & SKU mode.
3. Universal Period Selector in Store Analytics: Global period filter (Today, Yesterday, Last 7D, Last 30D, Month) now applies across all sales, category, item-wise velocity, and profit reports.
